# ECN-2026-038 - Change notice - Machining induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01

## Reason for change
Operational testing and process validation following ECN-2026-022 identified an offset in the control algorithm for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 that produces inconsistent charge-to-charge billet temperatures. To align machining billet output with forging metallurgical requirements and reduce rework, the control setpoint and associated procedural steps are being updated. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. This change standardizes the heater control to consistently achieve that target and to reflect lessons learned during the ECN-2026-022 implementation.

## Affected items
- Control configuration for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 (software setpoint and HMI label)
- SOP-P1-L3-01: Pre-heat and charge handling procedures (text and checklist updates)
- SOP-P1-L3-02: Heater start-up and shutdown sequence (sequence and acceptance criteria)
- Operator training records and deviation logs for P1-L3 line operations
- Process monitoring dashboards and alarm thresholds related to billet temperature readings

## Implementation
- Update control setpoint and HMI label for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to reflect the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C.  
- Revise SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 to incorporate the new acceptance criteria and inspection checkpoints; include explicit verification of incoming billet temperature against 1235 °C during the holding/transfer step.  
- Execute a controlled rollout during a maintenance window on P1-L3 with supervision from process engineering. Perform three verification charges under observation and log results in the process validation record.  
- Update operator training modules and require sign-off on the revised SOPs prior to independent operation.

## Approvals
- Initiator: Process Engineering, P1-L3  
- Review: Operations Management, P1-L3  
- Compliance: Quality Assurance (references: ECN-2026-022, SOP-P1-L3-01, SOP-P1-L3-02)

Signatures and dates to be recorded in the document control system upon approval.
